text:
## Your Rights  
**8-Day Response Guarantee**
We will respond to your complaint within **8 calendar days** of receipt.  
**Free Ombudsman Escalation**
If you're unhappy with our response, you can escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service (free and independent).  
**No Retaliation**
We will not penalize you for making a complaint.  
**Full Investigation**
We will thoroughly investigate your complaint and provide a clear explanation.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Resolution Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for handling customer complaints with guaranteed response timelines, investigation obligations, and escalation rights to the Financial Ombudsman Service. The process includes formal investigation, clear explanation provision, and protection against retaliation.
context: We will respond to your complaint within 8 calendar days of receipt.
We will thoroughly investigate your complaint and provide a clear explanation.
We will not penalize you for making a complaint.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Receipt and Response
raw_entities.description: Initial step in complaint handling where the bank acknowledges receipt of the complaint and commits to providing a substantive response within a defined timeline.
context: We will respond to your complaint within 8 calendar days of receipt.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Investigation and Explanation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory investigation step where the bank thoroughly examines the complaint and prepares a clear, detailed explanation of findings and actions taken.
context: We will thoroughly investigate your complaint and provide a clear explanation.

raw_entities.name: Retaliation Protection Assurance
raw_entities.description: Procedural commitment to protect customers from any adverse treatment or penalties as a result of filing a complaint.
context: We will not penalize you for making a complaint.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Resolution Satisfaction Gate
raw_entities.description: Decision point where the customer determines whether the bank's response resolves their complaint or whether escalation to the Financial Ombudsman Service is required.
context: If you're unhappy with our response, you can escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service (free and independent).

raw_entities.name: Level 1 — Bank Complaint Resolution
raw_entities.description: First escalation level where the bank investigates and responds to the complaint within 8 calendar days. This is the internal resolution tier before external ombudsman involvement.
context: We will respond to your complaint within 8 calendar days of receipt.
We will thoroughly investigate your complaint and provide a clear explanation.

raw_entities.name: Level 2 — Financial Ombudsman Service Escalation
raw_entities.description: Second escalation level providing independent, free review of the complaint by the Financial Ombudsman Service if the customer remains dissatisfied with the bank's internal response.
context: If you're unhappy with our response, you can escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service (free and independent).

raw_entities.name: Bank Complaint Handler
raw_entities.description: Internal bank role responsible for receiving complaints, conducting thorough investigation, and providing clear explanations to customers within the 8-day response guarantee.
context: We will respond to your complaint within 8 calendar days of receipt.
We will thoroughly investigate your complaint and provide a clear explanation.

raw_entities.name: Financial Ombudsman Service
raw_entities.description: Independent external authority that provides free escalation and review of complaints when customers are dissatisfied with the bank's internal resolution.
context: If you're unhappy with our response, you can escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service (free and independent).

raw_entities.name: Complaining Customer
raw_entities.description: Customer who files a complaint with the bank and has rights to investigation, response within 8 days, escalation to ombudsman, and protection from retaliation.
context: If you're unhappy with our response, you can escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service (free and independent).
We will not penalize you for making a complaint.
